CustomField.description: The assessment question this marker belongs to, joined on ALTF__Assessment_Question__c.ALTF__AltifyId__c - the field the org itself treats as the question's identity and the one AAO_Discovery already upserts on. Keyed to the CODE and never to the question text, because the text is the org's to rewrite and a marker keyed to a sentence would come loose the first time somebody edited it.
CustomField.label: Question Code
